in_sanskrit.name: मायवांश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the descendant of the illusory or magical power.

in_marathi.name: Mayvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ma’ meaning mother and ‘Vansh’ meaning lineage or progeny. This name is a reverence to Lord Shiva, the supreme deity, who is the creator and destroyer of the universe. It is believed that Mayvansh bestows upon the child the blessings of Lord Shiva, ensuring a prosperous and fulfilling life.

This name is a reverence to Lord Shiva, the supreme deity, who is the creator and destroyer of the universe. It is believed that Mayvansh bestows upon the child the blessings of Lord Shiva, ensuring a prosperous and fulfilling life.
